office.subject: reception
office.rationale: Reception desks serve arriving visitors and deliveries, so they must be immediately visible and accessible from the main entry without passing through secure or operational areas.

office.subject: waiting_area
office.rationale: Visitors typically queue and wait near the reception desk before being directed or processed, minimizing movement through the office.

office.subject: restroom
office.rationale: Restrooms must be accessible to all staff and visitors from main circulation paths, not from private offices or meeting rooms.

office.subject: meeting_room
office.rationale: Meeting rooms serve multiple teams across the office and must be easily accessible without disrupting focused work areas.

office.subject: focus_room
office.rationale: Quiet focus rooms for concentration should be located away from main circulation and high-traffic areas to reduce noise and interruption.

office.subject: private_office
office.rationale: Private offices should be accessed from circulation rather than through other private spaces, maintaining privacy boundaries.

office.subject: support_space
office.rationale: Mail rooms, coat check, and package handling spaces benefit from proximity to the entry point where deliveries and visitor needs concentrate.

office.subject: break_room
office.rationale: Break rooms should be centrally accessible to promote staff gathering and informal collaboration without excessive walking.

office.subject: storage
office.rationale: File and supply storage should not occupy prime occupied space; it typically belongs in secondary locations or integrated into support areas.

office.subject: phone_booth
office.rationale: Isolated phone booths generate noise and activity that conflicts with quiet zones; they belong near circulation or open areas.

office.subject: stair
office.rationale: Stairs must be part of accessible, obvious circulation routes, typically centrally located in multi-story offices.

office.subject: cleaning_storage
office.rationale: Housekeeping supplies and equipment storage should be located near service access and away from primary tenant spaces.

office.subject: elevator
office.rationale: Elevators should open directly onto main circulation vestibules to manage waiting and traffic flow efficiently.

office.subject: server_room
office.rationale: IT equipment rooms generate heat and noise and should be isolated from occupied spaces; they benefit from perimeter or utility core placement.

office.subject: open_plan
office.rationale: Open-plan areas benefit from adjacent meeting spaces where informal discussions can be held without disturbing focus work.

office.subject: shared_circulation
office.rationale: All occupied spaces must be accessible from circulation routes meeting accessibility standards for people with disabilities.

clinic.subject: waiting_area
clinic.rationale: Patients arrive at public entry and must be immediately directed to waiting; this space is the first patient interaction point.

clinic.subject: reception
clinic.rationale: Reception staff must supervise the waiting area to check in arriving patients, manage flow, and respond to requests.

clinic.subject: exam_room
clinic.rationale: Exam rooms must be accessed from clinical corridors, not from public waiting or reception, to control patient flow and privacy.

clinic.subject: staff_area
clinic.rationale: Staff work areas, break rooms, and charting stations should have separate access from the public entry to maintain operational independence.

clinic.subject: clean_utility_room
clinic.rationale: Clean and soiled utility areas must have separate locations and routes to prevent cross-contamination and maintain infection control.

clinic.subject: public_restroom
clinic.rationale: Public and staff restrooms must be separate to maintain hygiene standards and prevent cross-contamination between patients and staff.

clinic.subject: nurse_station
clinic.rationale: Nurse stations should be centrally located near exam rooms to support quick response, vital monitoring, and patient supervision.

clinic.subject: service_loading
clinic.rationale: Loading docks and service entries must be separate from public areas to prevent disruption and maintain clinic atmosphere.

clinic.subject: exam_room
clinic.rationale: Each exam room must have direct private access without visibility from corridors or other spaces for patient dignity and HIPAA compliance.

clinic.subject: procedure_room
clinic.rationale: Procedure rooms require preparation and hand-washing access before entering to maintain sterile field and infection control protocols.

clinic.subject: lab_area
clinic.rationale: Lab areas benefit from proximity to exam rooms to enable rapid specimen collection and testing during patient visits.

clinic.subject: imaging_room
clinic.rationale: Imaging areas may serve multiple departments and should be independently accessible, though still maintaining patient privacy.

clinic.subject: supply_storage
clinic.rationale: Bulk medical supply storage should not occupy clinical treatment space; it typically belongs in utility areas away from patient flow.

clinic.subject: hand_wash
clinic.rationale: Hand-washing stations must be immediately accessible before entering each exam room per infection control standards.

clinic.subject: patient_area
clinic.rationale: Patient flow from check-in to exam should be direct and logical, minimizing backtracking and exposure to other areas.

hospital.subject: emergency_department
hospital.rationale: Emergency departments must have a separate, immediately accessible entry to enable rapid triage and prevent interference with other hospital operations.

hospital.subject: nursing_station
hospital.rationale: Nursing stations must be positioned to supervise patient areas and enable rapid response to calls and monitoring needs.

hospital.subject: clean_utility
hospital.rationale: Clean and soiled supply routes must be completely separate to prevent cross-contamination throughout the hospital.

hospital.subject: operating_room
hospital.rationale: Operating rooms must be accessed only from restricted sterile corridors where gowning and hand-washing occur to maintain sterile fields.

hospital.subject: icu_bed
hospital.rationale: ICU beds must have direct visibility and immediate access from nursing stations for continuous monitoring of critical patients.

hospital.subject: imaging_department
hospital.rationale: Radiology and imaging serve all departments and should be centrally located with accessible entry from main hospital circulation.

hospital.subject: laboratory
hospital.rationale: Central laboratory must be accessible to all clinical areas for specimen transport and processing.

hospital.subject: pharmacy
hospital.rationale: Pharmacies must have restricted access to control medication distribution and prevent unauthorized entry.

hospital.subject: visitor_waiting
hospital.rationale: Visitor waiting areas should be located near inpatient units to enable convenient access while managing traffic control.

hospital.subject: morgue
hospital.rationale: Morgue facilities must have completely separate, dignified access away from public and patient circulation areas.

hospital.subject: respiratory_isolation_room
hospital.rationale: Respiratory isolation rooms must have separate ventilation and access routes from general wards to prevent airborne pathogen spread.

hospital.subject: recovery_room
hospital.rationale: Recovery areas must be immediately adjacent to labor-delivery rooms to enable rapid patient transfer and monitoring continuity.

hospital.subject: supply_distribution
hospital.rationale: Central supply distribution should be accessible from main circulation without crossing clinical areas to enable efficient restocking.

hospital.subject: loading_dock
hospital.rationale: Service loading must have independent access separate from patient and visitor entries to prevent disruption.

hospital.subject: code_cart_station
hospital.rationale: Code cart and emergency equipment stations must be immediately accessible from nursing areas for rapid emergency response.

hospital.subject: outpatient_waiting
hospital.rationale: Outpatient waiting areas must be immediately accessible from the clinic entry point, functioning as the first contact space for ambulatory patients.

hospital.subject: exam_room
hospital.rationale: Outpatient exam rooms must be accessed from designated clinical corridors, preventing direct access from waiting areas to maintain infection control and patient privacy.

hospital.subject: nurse_alcove
hospital.rationale: Nurse alcoves and support spaces for charting, medication prep, and supply should be immediately adjacent to clusters of exam rooms for efficiency and supervision.

hospital.subject: soiled_supply_room
hospital.rationale: Clean and soiled utility rooms must have separate locations and direct access to exterior or service routes, never sharing transportation paths to prevent cross-contamination in outpatient clinics.

hospital.subject: exam_room
hospital.rationale: Each outpatient exam room must have a private entrance or vestibule shielded from corridor visibility to protect patient dignity and comply with privacy standards.

datacenter.subject: mantrap
datacenter.rationale: Mantrap security vestibules must be the only entry point to data halls, with interlocked doors preventing simultaneous access to restricted areas.

datacenter.subject: data_hall
datacenter.rationale: Data hall access must be exclusively through mantrap with no direct entry from other areas to maintain security and environmental control.

datacenter.subject: cooling_room
datacenter.rationale: Cooling and electrical mechanical spaces should not share rooms to simplify independent maintenance and prevent interference between systems.

datacenter.subject: hot_aisle
datacenter.rationale: Hot and cold aisles must be completely separated within data halls to prevent mixing of exhaust and intake air for cooling efficiency.

datacenter.subject: power_distribution
datacenter.rationale: Power distribution rooms should be immediately adjacent to data halls to minimize cable runs and voltage drops.

datacenter.subject: network_distribution
datacenter.rationale: Network switch and fiber distribution points should be centrally located relative to data halls for efficient cabling.

datacenter.subject: loading_dock
datacenter.rationale: Service loading must have independent access from security entry to enable equipment delivery without compromising security protocols.

datacenter.subject: data_hall_a
datacenter.rationale: Redundant data hall paths (A/B) must have separate cooling, power, and access routes to ensure one failure does not cascade.

datacenter.subject: emergency_shutoff
datacenter.rationale: Emergency power shutdown switches must be easily accessible from main circulation routes in case of fire or critical event.

datacenter.subject: chiller_room
datacenter.rationale: Chiller rooms should be in separate spaces from data halls to contain noise and vibration and enable independent maintenance.

datacenter.subject: crac_crah_unit
datacenter.rationale: CRAC and CRAH cooling units must be positioned within or immediately adjacent to data halls for effective hot aisle cooling.

datacenter.subject: fire_suppression_control
datacenter.rationale: Fire suppression system controls must be easily accessible and visible from main circulation areas for emergency operation.

datacenter.subject: monitoring_center
datacenter.rationale: Security monitoring stations should be near main entry points to enable visibility of all critical access points and rapid response.

datacenter.subject: ups_battery_room
datacenter.rationale: UPS battery rooms must be accessible from electrical rooms for maintenance and replacement of aging battery modules.

datacenter.subject: admin_office
datacenter.rationale: Administrative offices should be in separate zones from secured data halls to enable different access levels and environmental needs.

airport.subject: landside_public
airport.rationale: Landside (public) and airside (secure) areas must have completely separate circulation, accessible only through security screening checkpoints.

airport.subject: security_checkpoint
airport.rationale: Security screening is the mandatory single gateway between landside public areas and airside restricted areas.

airport.subject: check_in_area
airport.rationale: Passenger check-in counters must be immediately accessible from the main public entry to facilitate arriving passenger flow.

airport.subject: departure_lounge
airport.rationale: Departure lounges are airside and accessible only through security, segregating departing passengers from public areas.

airport.subject: baggage_claim
airport.rationale: Baggage claim carousels must be directly adjacent to the arrivals hall where deplaning passengers immediately retrieve luggage.

airport.subject: customs_area
airport.rationale: Customs and immigration processing must follow baggage claim in the arrivals sequence, accessible directly from the arrivals hall.

airport.subject: gate
airport.rationale: Gates must be accessed from concourse corridors with no mixed public/airside flow through the gate areas.

airport.subject: gate
airport.rationale: Gates should be clustered along concourse spines to minimize walking distance for connecting passengers.

airport.subject: employee_entry
airport.rationale: Airport employees must have separate security-controlled entry points from public passengers to prevent security breaches.

airport.subject: crew_rest_room
airport.rationale: Crew rest and briefing areas must be airside-accessible without returning to public areas.

airport.subject: maintenance_area
airport.rationale: Aircraft maintenance and service areas require separate controlled access independent of passenger and gate operations.

airport.subject: cargo_area
airport.rationale: Cargo loading and handling must be completely separate from passenger areas with independent vehicle access.

airport.subject: information_desk
airport.rationale: Information desks should be prominently located along concourses at natural passenger gathering points.

airport.subject: retail_dining
airport.rationale: Retail and dining facilities belong along concourses and near gate areas to serve passengers waiting for flights.

airport.subject: family_room
airport.rationale: Dedicated family rest rooms should be accessible from both landside and airside terminal areas for passenger comfort.
